full_name: Anand Vaidya | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Anand Vaidya is a doctoral candidate in the Department of Anthropology at Harvard University. He studies environmental politics and social movements in India.
